title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000  clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas. Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR  para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH. Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você! Responsabilidades e atribuições  Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna; Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia; Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas; Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política; Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições; Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento; People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão; Automação e IA aplicada ao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área; Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados.  Requisitos e qualificações  Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência consolidada em Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais; Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets; Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares); Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão.  Também é legal se você tiver:  Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH; Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes de startup; Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial; Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are  MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry. What the Platform Team Does at MAVI  Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service. About the Role  We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows. What You'll Do   Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve  as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships  with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process  by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.  What We’re Looking For  At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.  Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric. High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information. Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change. Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach. Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.  Why You Should Join  Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business. No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness. Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :) Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.  Equal Opportunity Statement  At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Empresa está contratando Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Toptal  is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand. A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert  is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries. The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements. The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions. Task and deliverables:  Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization. Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools. Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules. Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities. Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response. Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices. Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries. Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team. Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.  Required experience:  Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience. Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts. Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation. Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases. Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development. Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation. Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance. Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team. Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams. Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.  Engagement highlights:  Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries. Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design. Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional. O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais. Responsabilidades e atribuições  Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI; Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores; Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs; Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs); Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders; Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade; Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI; Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas; Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas; Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis; Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.  Requisitos e qualificações:  Obrigatórios  Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação; Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance; Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados; Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores; Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.  Desejáveis  Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI; Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.); Experiência em Data & Analytics; Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT); Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma); Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.  Diferenciais do perfil  Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI; Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional; Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio; Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua. Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role  We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis. Responsibilities:  Manage large amounts of incoming tickets. Provide support to answer inquiries on products. Accept and handle technical requests. Triage tickets to the other teams. Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools. Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication. Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution. Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents. Take the extra mile to engage customers. Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.  Skills And Qualifications:  A Bachelor’s degree completed 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support roles Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English. Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion. Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics. Attention to detail is key to this position. Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs. Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills. Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).  Why Join JoVE?  A competitive compensation package. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do  Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps  What We're Looking For  Required  Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation  Nice to Have  Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation  Why Theta Data  Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities  1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)  Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.  2. Script-to-Audio Alignment  Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.  3. Technical & Creative Accuracy  Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble  4. Vendor & Artist Coordination  Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.  Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.  5. QC Documentation & Tracking  Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.  6. Pre-Release Quality Checks  Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.  7. Cross-Team Collaboration  Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.  8. Process Improvement  Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology  9. Volume & Deadline Management  Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content  within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.  10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement  Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery  Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.What the work looks likeYou will own client projects end to end.That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.Recent Zaigo-style projects include:a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rulesa benchmarking platform built from years of public company filingspayroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually useinternal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomyYou do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.Who we are looking forYou are probably a fit if this sounds like you:You have 5+ years building software professionally.You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.You think like a product owner. You ask what the user is trying to do, what the first useful version should be, and what will make people trust the system.You can work with ambiguity. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.Who should not applyThis is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.ProcessShort application.10-minute async voice interview.Live interview with Zaigo's founder.Short practical build project.Offer if it is a fit.We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.

Job Responsibilities: Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst  Introduction:  We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst  to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes. Roles and Responsibilities:  Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve. Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) , Schedule B , and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)  classifications. Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each). Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI)  foundation for global import classifications. Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team. Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program. Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes. Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities. Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives.  Qualifications:  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)  and detailed reports. Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred. Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues.  Tools and Technologies:  Proficient in Smartsheet , Power BI , and AWS Quicksight  with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports. Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation. Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus.  Skills:  Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.  Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation. Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment. Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.  Required Qualifications:  Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain. Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies. Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation. Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Offer Details:  Commitments Required :  4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract  : 8 weeks.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Empresa está contratando Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

About Turing:  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:  You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:  TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;
